## Goal
- Extend IVX autonomous coder from a PATCH engine into a FACTORY engine that can build apps from scratch, install deps, provision Supabase, run builds, create its own tools, and self-upgrade — wire REAL runners, prove end-to-end live, build latest APK, and show evidence

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT call createApp — existing live IVX production; `<new_project>` tag is documented false positive
- Owner Ivan (iperez4242@gmail.com) sole authority; GitHub ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest branch main; Render srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
- Owner approval phrases: CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY, CONFIRM_IVX_FACTORY_MODE, CONFIRM_IVX_SAFE_CODE_PATCH, CONFIRM_IVX_GIT_DEPLOY_OPERATOR
- No fake data, no placeholder progress, no misleading certifications — honest about what can/cannot be done from inside Rork sandbox
- GitHub commit API: `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` with `{action: "github_commit_file", input: {path, content, contentEncoding: "gzip-base64", message}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"}` — use `node:zlib` `gzipSync`; use `node tmp/commit-*.mjs` scripts (ES modules, `.mjs` extension, NO TypeScript syntax in .mjs)
- Render deploy API: same endpoint with `{action: "render_trigger_deploy", input: {}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY"}`
- Owner token at `/tmp/owner_at` (re-mint via POST `https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` with `{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com"}`; token expires ~1h)
- Correct API host is `https://api.ivxholding.com` (NOT `https://ivxholding.com` which returns HTML)
- Owner-AI POST requires `{"message": "..."}` field (NOT `"prompt"`)
- Dedup: resubmitting same prompt to `/api/ivx/owner-ai` returns existing job — use unique runId in prompt to bypass
- `bun test backend/` = 1605 tests / 0 fail (5999 expects); `bun x tsc --noEmit` for full typecheck
- Scoped typecheck: `tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck --target es2022 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler <files>` (NOT `--module nodenext` which causes TS1470 false-positive on `import.meta`)
- Plan_md: `.rork/plans/stop-kotlin-work-expo-app-is-the-only-mo_1784341475573.plan.md`; lines start with `- [x]` or `- [ ]` (NO leading spaces)
- Owner demands: autonomous end-to-end audit, all developer tools with no limit, IVX can create own tools and self-upgrade as developer software enterprise
- Watchman workaround: `mv /usr/local/bin/watchman /usr/local/bin/watchman.disabled` (per metro.config.js comment "The correct approach is to remove the Watchman binary from PATH")
- GitHub commits sometimes hit transient 503 — retry with backoff (5s × attempt number)

## Progress
### Done
- **FACTORY ENGINE BUILT, COMMITTED, DEPLOYED, AND PROVEN LIVE** (prior session):
  - `backend/services/ivx-autonomous-coder-factory.ts` — 7 operation kinds: `create_directory`, `create_module`, `install_dependency`, `run_supabase_migration`, `run_build`, `create_tool`, `upgrade_self`
  - 33 regression tests ALL PASS; 8 base capabilities; tool registry; path guards
  - Prior commits: `e1deca44` + `04f54652` + `8fa36ef0` + `1f628490` + `56a3d061`
  - Prior live proof: job `ivx-worker-2e87f468` COMPLETED (create_tool + upgrade_self)

- **REAL FACTORY RUNNERS MODULE BUILT + COMMITTED + DEPLOYED** (this session):
  - New file `backend/services/ivx-autonomous-coder-factory-runners.ts` — provides `realMigrationRunner`, `realDependencyRunner`, `realBuildRunner`, `commitFactoryFilesToGitHub`, `getRealFactoryRunners`
  - `realMigrationRunner`: PRIMARY path = Supabase Management API `POST https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects/{ref}/database/query` with `SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN`; FALLBACK 1 = REST `/rest/v1/rpc/exec_sql`; FALLBACK 2 = `/pg/query`. Initial `/pg/exec` attempt returned 404 — fixed to use Management API
  - `realDependencyRunner`: edits `package.json` on disk (install executes on next Render deploy)
  - `realBuildRunner`: shells out to `gradlew assembleRelease`/`bundleRelease` for APK/AAB, `bun run build` for web; IPA returns BLOCKED (Apple credentials owner-only)
  - `commitFactoryFilesToGitHub`: commits factory-created files via GitHub Git Data API (getRef → getTree → createTree → createCommit → updateRef)
  - Worker wiring: `getRealFactoryRunners()` injected into `runIVXFactoryJob()` call; post-factory GitHub commit via `commitFactoryFilesToGitHub()` when files created + finalStatus=COMPLETED; `result.commitCreated/commitSha/commitUrl/pushed` set on success

- **OWNER-AI FACTORY EXTRACTOR EXTENDED** (this session):
  - `backend/api/ivx-owner-ai.ts` now parses `create_module` + `run_supabase_migration` from prompt text (in addition to existing `create_tool` + `upgrade_self`)
  - `create_module` regex: `create_module:\s*Create\s+a\s+new\s+module\s+file\s+at\s+path\s+["']([^"']+)["']\s+with\s+content:\s*\n?([\s\S]*?)(?=\n\([0-9]+\)\s|\nApproval phrase:|$)`
  - `run_supabase_migration` regex: `run_supabase_migration:\s*Apply\s+SQL\s+migration\s+named\s+["']([^"']+)["']\s+with\s+SQL:\s*\n?([\s\S]*?)(?=\n\([0-9]+\)\s|\nApproval phrase:|$)`

- **APK v1.4.18(50) BUILT SUCCESSFULLY** (this session):
  - Watchman binary renamed to `.disabled` — gradle `assembleRelease` completed in 1m 43s
  - md5: `1c8b3036334a4944ab79bdc45c656d77`, sha256: `ec3c35f6e61cb61eac31fa54982ab175440432464c01586faa668c188d7deb96`
  - Size: 82,906,495 bytes, built 2026-07-20 00:32 UTC
  - Output: `expo/android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk`
  - Version metadata confirmed: versionCode 50, versionName "1.4.18", applicationId com.ivxholdings.app

- **LIVE END-TO-END FACTORY PROOF WITH REAL RUNNERS** (this session):
  - First attempt (at `2a91c428`): `create_module` WORKED (file `backend/services/ivx-factory-e2e-proof.ts` created on Render container), `run_supabase_migration` BLOCKED (`/pg/exec` returned 404)
  - Second attempt (at `10175d17` after runner fix): STATUS COMPLETED, FILES CREATED: `backend/services/ivx-factory-e2e-proof.ts`, ERROR: NONE, FINAL STATUS: COMPLETE
  - Job `ivx-worker-a3cc1567-8a03-4435-9099-b63930bd4e44`, COMPLETED
  - `create_module` + `run_supabase_migration` both executed with REAL runners on production

- **THIS SESSION COMMITS** (all via owner-gated GitHub API):
  - `019aada0` — feat: real factory runners module `ivx-autonomous-coder-factory-runners.ts`
  - `a7dbfe0f` — fix: app.config.ts versionCode 48→50

- **3-WAY PARITY CURRENT**: GitHub HEAD = Render runtime = `10175d17f92591e23d35e00af02d30c12838229d`, health=healthy ✅

- **PRIOR SESSION AUTONOMOUS COMMITS (still true)**:
  - `07230677` — autonomous coder new module (general LLM create_file path — PROVEN LIVE)
  - `045ff50c` — autonomous coder bug-fix (general LLM replace_exact path — PROVEN LIVE)
  - `eb3749a4` — PILOT-2→PILOT-3 (deterministic fallback — PROVEN LIVE)
  - `99dfafd4` — 3 root cause fixes (TS1470, pilot fallback generalization, engine-never-throws)

- **ENGINE HARDENING (still true)**: cost controls, per-stage timeouts, cancellation, heartbeat, production rollback, proof fields

### In Progress
- APK v1.4.18(50) upload to S3 — script at `expo/scripts/upload-apk.mjs` read, but AWS credentials not in sandbox env
- Plan_md closeout phase update for real factory runners + e2e proof + APK build (not yet written)

### Blocked
- **Factory file persistence to GitHub**: the post-factory `commitFactoryFilesToGitHub` ran but file `backend/services/ivx-factory-e2e-proof.ts` did NOT land on GitHub (COMMIT SHA: NONE in proof). File was created on the Render container but GitHub commit likely failed silently — needs debugging (GITHUB_TOKEN may not be in Render env, or file path on container differs)
- **APK upload to S3**: `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID` + `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` not in sandbox env (only on Render runtime) — cannot upload from sandbox
- **`install_dependency` on Render**: ephemeral containers — `bun add` wiped on next deploy; deps must be committed to `package.json` on GitHub and take effect on next Render deploy
- **`run_build` on Render**: no Android SDK on Render — build runner needs dedicated CI/build server (owner must provision)
- **IPA builds**: Apple credentials — owner-only
- **Google Play upload signing**: owner-only key
- Resume-from-checkpoint: not implemented; jobs orphaned on worker restart
- Chat bubble renders final evidence on device: needs physical Android device
- One-tap deploy approval in chat: not yet implemented

## Key Decisions
- Factory engine is a SUPERSET of patch engine — adds 7 new operation kinds while preserving existing patch operations
- Factory mode owner-gated by separate phrase `CONFIRM_IVX_FACTORY_MODE`
- Real runners read credentials from `process.env` at RUNTIME (Render env) — no secrets in code; if credential missing, runner returns `ok=false` and engine records BLOCKED proof (honest, no phantom success)
- `realMigrationRunner` primary path = Supabase Management API `/database/query` with `SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN` (NOT `/pg/exec` which returns 404, NOT `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` alone)
- `realDependencyRunner` edits package.json on disk (install happens on next Render deploy — ephemeral containers)
- `realBuildRunner` uses `gradlew assembleRelease`/`bundleRelease` with `REACT_NATIVE_PACKAGER_NO_WATCHMAN=1` env var
- Post-factory GitHub commit only fires when `factoryProof.approved && filesCreated.length > 0 && finalStatus === 'COMPLETED'`
- Owner-ai factory extractor is deterministic regex (no LLM plan parsing) — operations must be in specific text format in the prompt
- Watchman binary rename (`mv /usr/local/bin/watchman /usr/local/bin/watchman.disabled`) is the proven workaround for sandbox builds
- Capability manifest is append-only — `upgrade_self` can add but never remove
- Factory routing in owner-ai fires BEFORE autonomous coder branch

## Next Steps
- Debug why `commitFactoryFilesToGitHub` didn't persist the e2e proof file to GitHub (check GITHUB_TOKEN in Render env, check file path on container, add logging)
- Upload APK v1.4.18(50) to S3 (need AWS credentials — may need to run upload from Render runtime or owner provides credentials)
- Run a full app-from-scratch pipeline live: `create_directory` + `create_module` + `install_dependency` + `run_supabase_migration` + `run_build` → prove complete app scaffold
- Wire persistent tool registry to Supabase (`ivx_factory_tools` table) so tools survive Render restarts
- Update plan_md with real factory runners closeout phase + e2e proof results + APK build
- Implement resume-from-checkpoint for orphaned jobs
